values.note: City of East Tawas, effective May 1, 2026. May 1 - October 31: lake lots $100 a day ($70 a day seasonally); all other lots $55 a day ($45 a day monthly, $40 seasonally). November 1 - May 1: all lots $30 a day, limited to 15 days a month. One rate for everyone. Camper cabin $150 a night.

fees.source: https://www.easttawas.com/government/parks___recreation/east_tawas_city_park/camping/daily_camping_fees.php ('EFFECTIVE MAY 1, 2026', 'LAKE LOTS: $100.00 (Daily)', 'ALL OTHER LOTS: $55.00 (Daily)', 'November 1 - May 1 ALL LOTS: $30.00(Daily) Limited to 15 days per month'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 178 full-hookup lots, lake lots among them; 'Maximum Length On Most Lots May Not Exceed 37 ft.' One camping unit per site; no tents.

values.note: 'NO RESERVATIONS - First Come, First Served.' Sites can be booked online on the city's Campspot page for the same day only ('Enter the current date as the reservation start date'); the camper cabin up to 6 months ahead. Extensions by 10 a.m. Day, week, month or season stays.

booking.source: https://www.easttawas.com/government/parks___recreation/east_tawas_city_park/camping/index.php ('all campsites are available for same-day reservations only', 'NO RESERVATIONS - First Come, First Served', 'SAME DAY ONLINE BOOKING NOW AVAILABLE!') + campground_rules.php ('EXTENSIONS MUST BE MADE BY 10:00 A.M.'), read 2026-10-25

note: City of East Tawas park on Lake Huron's Tawas Bay, downtown beside the harbor of refuge; 1,600-ft public swimming beach, state pier and launch nearby. Daily site allocation via a 10am waitlist; larger rigs than the posted limit reported off-season. Winter trailer storage on the lots Nov 1 - May 1. --Claude
summary: City camping, fee and rules pages: confirmed 178 full-hookup sites, water/sewer, FCFS; electric 30 -> 50 A ('20, 30 & 50 amp'); season May-Oct (derived) -> year-round; added 2026 fees ($55 daily, lake lots $100, $30 Nov-May), 37-ft limit, showers, Wi-Fi, same-day Campspot booking. Monthly and seasonal rates offered, no seasonal count (passes test 4). Note: dropped the wrong '30-amp' and 'Season ~May-Oct' and the field facts.
